row.notes: Computes raw dt = (now - last +0x98) / frequency +0xa8 into +0x78 (now is override +0xa0 or QPC), then by mode +0x48: 3 = exponential smoothing with factor +0x80, 4 = fixed step +0x68, 5 = fixed step plus Sleep(100), 6 = mean of the last 7 samples (+0x10..+0x40, index +8). Clamps to max +0x60 when +0x89 is set, stores final dt at +0x70 and updates +0x98. Hook +0x70 or +0x68 to change the step used by the game and FFB threads.
